title: Cult.fit IPO
summary: Cult.fit IPO is a book-built issue, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Cult.fit IPO has a total issue size of ₹960 Crores Fresh + 17.86 Crore shares OFS and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

Cult.fit financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Cult.Fit Limited was incorporated in May 2016 and operates as the largest fitness and active lifestyle company in India in terms of number of fitness centers. Through the company’s platform and vast network, Cult.Fit offers a combination of fitness services and fitness products that constitute its integrated fitness ecosystem. Cult.Fit runs 708 fitness centers across 77 Indian cities under brands such as Cult.fit, Fitness First, Gold's Gym, and Pilates Circle by Cult. This includes gym memberships, trainer led classes, sports, online classes, and wellness experiences. · The fitness products and services offered by Cult.Fit include active lifestyle product design, development, and sales that cover items including fitness equipment, recovery products, fitness accessories, activewear, and footwear through its brands. · Using its technology platform, artificial intelligence (AI), and omnichannel networks, Cult.Fit offers seamless customer experience across both offline and online channels while catering for nearly one million paid membership customers. · As of March 31, 2026, the company had a total workforce of 6,331 personnel in various departments including fitness, technology, marketing, customer care, products, finance, and corporate departments.
No Identifiable Promoter are the company's promoters of Cult.fit.
